body.message:
Sure, we can offer you this apartment at a rate of AED 8,500 for a 1-month stay (30 nights).

Please also note that a refundable security/damage deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The refundable deposit will be reimbursed within 7–14 working days after check-out, subject to a final inspection of the property. The deposit will be refunded in full via credit card or bank transfer, provided there are no damages or outstanding charges.

Thank you, and please let us know if you would like to proceed.
